name: Bolton / Malton; formerly Highway 27 / North York
description: The former 42 Bolton family had separate Highway 50–Malton and Highway 27–North York branches. The latter ended in 2019; a proposed total cancellation was revised to retain reduced Malton service.

timeline.event: GO introduced a Bolton–Nobleton–Kleinburg–Humber College–North York corridor.
The original 38A table shows the Highway 27 branch, two peak-direction trips each way.
A separately dated table documents 38 via Highway 50 to Malton GO.
Both 38 and 38A remain in the published booklet.
38A was eliminated. The planned total 38 cancellation was revised.
Reduced 38 retained two morning and two afternoon/evening trips, initially as an interim arrangement.

sources.title: 50 Years of GO Transit Bus Operations — historical chronology by Adam Zhelka / Toronto Transportation Society
Transit Toronto: GO Transit changes start April 26, published 22 April 2008
GO table 38: Highway 27 branch effective 30 August 2008; Highway 50 branch effective 1 December 2008
GO Bolton / Malton table 38, effective 1 September 2018
Town of Caledon staff report on GO Transit service reductions and route 38, 24 September 2019

gaps: See the separate 42 entry for the former number.
